Days.description:
Lifetime of the active copy in days. Do not use with restores that specify OutputLocation.

The Days element is required for regular restores, and must not be provided for select requests.

GlacierJobParameters.description: S3 Glacier related parameters pertaining to this job. Do not use with restores that specify OutputLocation.

Type of restore request.

Tier.description: Retrieval tier at which the restore will be processed.
